div.p: setup.ts Save config → discover paths → install OS service → fetch register link
push.ts Load config/state → collect → push → save state
status.ts Display config, daemon PID, sync state, tracked files
update.ts Check version → download tgz → npm install -g → re-setup

config.ts ─────────────── • AgentConfig (server_url, email) • AgentState (file_offsets, timestamps) • BUILT_IN_SERVER_URL (build-time) • discoverClaudePaths() • load/save Config & State • v1→v2 state migration
collector.ts ─────────────── • Scan JSONL from byte offsets • Parse usage entries (model, tokens) • Extract user prompts (uuid, content) • Discover projects via git remote • Prune stale file offsets
pusher.ts ─────────────── • Batch entries @1000, prompts @500 • POST /api/sync with metadata • Exponential backoff retry (5xx) • Collect hostname + IP
commander.ts ─────────────── • Poll GET /api/agent/commands • Execute: revoke-token, force-sync, update-config • ACK back to server
pricing.ts ─────────────── • Fetch LiteLLM pricing (24h cache) • Tiered cost calculation • Model name fuzzy matching
